grades.upper_bound_mechanism: periodicity with L = lcm of minimal generators, T = count of terms in a length-L window
grades.notes: Complete correct proof. Lemma 1.1 fully proves the term characterization (C). Sections 3–5 prove finiteness of the minimal generators (descent Lemma 4.1 bounding π(d) ≤ a₁p, then pigeonhole plus antichain contradiction) for all cases. Lemma 2.1 assembles global periodicity from a₁ with explicit T and L, yielding a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n ≥ 1.
